sideEffects.e: Bothersome **withdrawal**, especially after high-dose long-term use
Nausea, worse with the IR form

pearls: Dose-titrate skillfully: experienced prescribers use **titration** to cope with the unpredictable NET effect
Whether SNRIs truly beat SSRIs for remission or resistant depression is still **debated**, though the dual mechanism makes it plausible
Relieves **pain without depression** as well as depression without pain
Painful physical symptoms are **absent from the diagnostic criteria** for depression yet are common and a leading residual symptom

sideEffects.e: **Seizures** at peak plasma levels (reduced by SR and XL)

pearls: Not scheduled and not known to be **abusable**, yet effective for nicotine addiction
Helps patients who **cannot tolerate** serotonergic SSRI effects or fail to respond to them
Targets loss of joy, interest, pleasure, energy, enthusiasm, alertness and self-confidence
PFC has no DAT, so **NET blockade** there raises DA as well as NE
Added to sertraline, nicknamed “**Well-oft**” (Wellbutrin plus Zoloft)
Rationale: some depressed patients have **out-of-sync rhythms** and low nocturnal melatonin
Shares **5HT2C antagonism** with fluoxetine, trazodone, mirtazapine and some TCAs; olanzapine and quetiapine too, for bipolar depression
**5HT3 blockade** may protect against serotonin-driven GI side effects such as nausea
**5HT2A blockade** improves slow-wave sleep, helpful in many depressed patients
SNRI plus mirtazapine gives a theoretical **quadruple boost** of 5HT and NE (reuptake, α2, 5HT2A, 5HT2C blockade) and possibly extra DA
Reuptake blockade and **α2 antagonism are synergistic**, so combining them disinhibits 5HT and NE much more

sideEffects.e: Daytime **sedation** at peak levels with IR antidepressant dosing
No sexual dysfunction or weight gain; less insomnia and anxiety than SSRIs

pearls: Best hypnotic delivery is a **standard immediate-release** oral form: quick onset, gone by morning
Original IR antidepressant dosing was short-acting and needed **multiple daily doses** above hypnotic doses
Hypnotic action from the first dose gives **rapid onset** and better tolerability than SSRIs/SNRIs
Treating residual insomnia may also lift **remission rates** by improving energy and mood
Combined **α1 + 5HT2A blockade** is thought to boost PFC dopamine release
